---
title: "Fig. 3B: full TRUST4 contigs vs V-J clipped sequences"
---

The published Fig. 3B scores the pre/post treatment sequences as full TRUST4 contigs (leader/5' UTR and
the start of the constant region included; `dataset/build_treatment_dataset.Rmd`), while the sequence
classifiers were trained on IgBLAST V-J sequences that passed the classifier-dataset filters
(`dataset/build_dataset.Rmd`). `dataset/09_treatment_vj.R` makes the consistent variant (`vj`); this
notebook compares the two: how many sequences pass the filters and how much is trimmed, how the
per-sequence scores agree, and how the patient scores and paired tests of Fig. 3B change.

Variants in the tests: `contig` (published), `contig_pass` (contig scores of only the sequences that pass
the IgBLAST filters, which separates the filtering from the clipping) and `vj`.

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(tidyverse); library(vroom); library(patchwork)})

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
BASE <- out_path("sequence-classifier")

# Fig. 3B settings, as in analysis/treatment_analysis.Rmd (default tissue view)
KNOWN_DRUGS    <- c("Natalizumab", "Fingolimod", "Ocrelizumab", "DMF")
BENNETT_TISSUE <- c(Fingolimod = "Blood", Natalizumab = "CSF")
SCORE_PCT      <- 90
MODELS <- c(exclusion = "LM Exclusion AUGC", baseline = "LM Baseline AUGC")

META <- c("Author", "Subject", "Run", "Treatment", "timepoint", "BSource", "Disease",
          "Disease Class", "Patient State", "EDSS", "consensus_count")
```

```{r load}
read_pred <- function(variant, model, extra = character()) {
  f <- file.path(BASE, sprintf("treatment_predictions%s_%s.csv", if (variant == "contig") "" else "_vj", model))
  vroom(f, col_select = any_of(c(META, extra, "ms_score")), show_col_types = FALSE,
        col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), consensus_count = col_double(), ms_score = col_double())) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(c("contig_row", "v_sequence_start", "j_sequence_end")), as.integer))
}

contig <- read_pred("contig", "exclusion", "sequence") %>%
  mutate(contig_row = row_number(), len_contig = nchar(sequence), .keep = "unused") %>%
  rename(contig_exclusion = ms_score) %>%
  mutate(contig_baseline = read_pred("contig", "baseline")$ms_score)

vj <- read_pred("vj", "exclusion", c("contig_row", "v_sequence_start", "j_sequence_end", "sequence")) %>%
  mutate(len_vj = nchar(sequence), .keep = "unused") %>%
  rename(vj_exclusion = ms_score) %>%
  mutate(vj_baseline = read_pred("vj", "baseline")$ms_score)

seqs <- contig %>%
  left_join(select(vj, contig_row, v_sequence_start, j_sequence_end, len_vj, vj_exclusion, vj_baseline),
            by = "contig_row") %>%
  mutate(pass = !is.na(vj_exclusion), trim_5p = v_sequence_start - 1L, trim_3p = len_contig - j_sequence_end)

# The vj rows must be the contig rows they claim to be
chk <- vj %>% select(contig_row, Author, Run, Subject) %>% left_join(contig, by = "contig_row", suffix = c("", ".c"))
stopifnot(nrow(vj) == sum(seqs$pass), identical(chk$Author, chk$Author.c), identical(chk$Run, chk$Run.c),
          identical(chk$Subject, chk$Subject.c))
cat(sprintf("%s contig sequences, %s pass the IgBLAST filters (%.1f%%)\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(seqs)), scales::comma(sum(seqs$pass)), 100 * mean(seqs$pass)))
```

## Filter pass rate and trimming

```{r pass-rates}
pass_rates <- seqs %>%
  group_by(Author, BSource, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(n_contig = n(), n_vj = sum(pass), pass_pct = 100 * mean(pass),
            median_len_contig = median(len_contig), median_len_vj = median(len_vj, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_trim_5p = median(trim_5p, na.rm = TRUE), median_trim_3p = median(trim_3p, na.rm = TRUE),
            untrimmed_pct = 100 * mean(trim_5p == 0 & trim_3p == 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
pass_rates %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## Per-sequence score agreement (sequences that pass the filters)

```{r per-sequence}
agreement <- function(x, y) {
  top_x <- x >= quantile(x, 0.9); top_y <- y >= quantile(y, 0.9)
  tibble(n = length(x), pearson = cor(x, y), spearman = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"),
         mean_contig = mean(x), mean_vj = mean(y), mean_shift = mean(y - x),
         ms_call_contig = mean(x > 0.5), ms_call_vj = mean(y > 0.5),
         top_decile_overlap = sum(top_x & top_y) / sum(top_x))
}
paired_scores <- seqs %>% filter(pass) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(contig_exclusion, contig_baseline, vj_exclusion, vj_baseline),
               names_to = c(".value", "model"), names_sep = "_")

seq_summary <- bind_rows(
  paired_scores %>% group_by(model) %>% group_modify(~ agreement(.x$contig, .x$vj)) %>%
    mutate(Author = "All studies", BSource = "All", timepoint = "All"),
  paired_scores %>% group_by(model, Author, BSource, timepoint) %>% group_modify(~ agreement(.x$contig, .x$vj))
) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(pass_rates, Author, BSource, timepoint, pass_pct, median_trim_5p, median_trim_3p),
            by = c("Author", "BSource", "timepoint")) %>%
  relocate(model, Author, BSource, timepoint)
seq_summary %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
write_csv(seq_summary, file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "treatment_contig_vs_vj_sequences.csv"))
```

## Fig. 3B under each variant

The aggregation and tests are those of `analysis/treatment_analysis.Rmd` (consensus-count-weighted 90th
percentile per run, baseline/post means per patient, paired Wilcoxon per drug facet and over all studies).

```{r fig3b-functions}
weighted_percentile <- function(scores, weights, p) {
  if (length(scores) == 1L) return(scores)
  idx <- order(scores)
  cum_w <- cumsum(as.numeric(weights[idx])); cum_w <- cum_w / cum_w[length(cum_w)]
  approx(cum_w, scores[idx], xout = p / 100, rule = 2)$y
}

fig3b_paired <- function(raw_preds) {
  patient_tx <- raw_preds %>%
    group_by(model, Author, Subject, Run, Treatment, timepoint, BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`, `Patient State`, EDSS) %>%
    summarize(ms_score_pct = weighted_percentile(ms_score, consensus_count, SCORE_PCT), n_seqs = n(), .groups = "drop")
  post_rows <- patient_tx %>% filter(timepoint == "post") %>%
    mutate(drug = str_extract(Treatment, paste(KNOWN_DRUGS, collapse = "|")),
           tx_months = as.numeric(str_extract(Treatment, "\\d+(?=\\s*months?)"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(drug))
  baseline_rows <- patient_tx %>% filter(timepoint == "baseline") %>%
    inner_join(post_rows %>% distinct(model, Author, Subject, BSource, drug),
               by = c("model", "Author", "Subject", "BSource"), relationship = "many-to-many")
  parsed <- bind_rows(post_rows, baseline_rows) %>%
    mutate(drug_label = if_else(!is.na(tx_months), paste0(drug, " ", tx_months, "mo (", Author, ")"),
                                paste0(drug, " (", Author, ")"))) %>%
    filter(!(Author == "BennettMS" & drug %in% names(BENNETT_TISSUE) & BSource != BENNETT_TISSUE[drug]))
  baseline_agg <- parsed %>% filter(timepoint == "baseline") %>%
    group_by(model, Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`, drug) %>%
    summarize(baseline_pct = mean(ms_score_pct), .groups = "drop")
  post_agg <- parsed %>% filter(timepoint == "post") %>%
    group_by(model, Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`, drug, drug_label, tx_months) %>%
    summarize(post_pct = mean(ms_score_pct), .groups = "drop")
  inner_join(baseline_agg, post_agg, by = c("model", "Author", "Subject", "BSource", "Disease", "Disease Class", "drug")) %>%
    mutate(delta_pct = post_pct - baseline_pct)
}

paired_tests <- function(paired) {
  wt <- function(.x) {
    w <- wilcox.test(.x$post_pct, .x$baseline_pct, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
    tibble(statistic = w$statistic, p.value = w$p.value, n_pairs = nrow(.x),
           mean_delta = mean(.x$delta_pct), n_down = sum(.x$delta_pct < 0))
  }
  per_study <- paired %>% group_by(model, drug_label, BSource) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_modify(~ wt(.x)) %>% group_by(model) %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup()
  all_studies <- paired %>% group_by(model, BSource) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_modify(~ wt(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(drug_label = "All studies")
  bind_rows(per_study, all_studies)
}
```

```{r fig3b-variants}
as_raw <- function(df, prefix) {
  map_dfr(names(MODELS), ~ df %>% mutate(model = MODELS[[.x]], ms_score = .data[[paste0(prefix, "_", .x)]]))
}
variants <- list(contig      = as_raw(seqs, "contig"),
                 contig_pass = as_raw(filter(seqs, pass), "contig"),
                 vj          = as_raw(filter(seqs, pass), "vj"))
paired <- imap_dfr(variants, ~ fig3b_paired(.x) %>% mutate(variant = .y))
tests  <- paired %>% group_by(variant) %>% group_modify(~ paired_tests(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, names(variants))) %>%
  arrange(model, drug_label, BSource, variant) %>%
  relocate(model, drug_label, BSource, variant, n_pairs)
write_csv(tests, file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "treatment_contig_vs_vj_tests.csv"))

tests %>% filter(model == MODELS[["exclusion"]]) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

The two tests quoted in the text (exclusion model): Fingolimod blood, n = 10 (PRJNA1054089, 12 months)
and natalizumab CSF, n = 4 (BennettMS). The `contig` rows reproduce the published values.

```{r quoted-tests}
tests %>%
  filter(model == MODELS[["exclusion"]],
         drug_label %in% c("Fingolimod 12mo (PRJNA1054089)", "Natalizumab 6mo (BennettMS)")) %>%
  select(drug_label, BSource, variant, n_pairs, statistic, p.value, mean_delta, n_down)
```

```{r patient-agreement}
patient_cmp <- paired %>%
  select(variant, model, Author, Subject, BSource, drug_label, baseline_pct, post_pct, delta_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variant, values_from = c(baseline_pct, post_pct, delta_pct))
patient_cmp %>% group_by(model) %>%
  summarize(n_pairs = n(), n_missing_vj = sum(is.na(delta_pct_vj)),
            cor_score = cor(c(baseline_pct_contig, post_pct_contig), c(baseline_pct_vj, post_pct_vj), use = "complete.obs"),
            mean_score_shift = mean(c(baseline_pct_vj - baseline_pct_contig, post_pct_vj - post_pct_contig), na.rm = TRUE),
            cor_delta = cor(delta_pct_contig, delta_pct_vj, use = "complete.obs"),
            delta_sign_agreement = mean(sign(delta_pct_contig) == sign(delta_pct_vj), na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
ex <- MODELS[["exclusion"]]
pa <- seqs %>% filter(pass) %>%
  ggplot(aes(contig_exclusion, vj_exclusion)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 50) + scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", name = "Sequences") +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") + facet_wrap(~BSource) + coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "MS score, contig", y = "MS score, V-J", title = "A  Per-sequence scores (exclusion model)")

pts <- patient_cmp %>% filter(model == ex) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(baseline_pct_contig, post_pct_contig, baseline_pct_vj, post_pct_vj),
               names_to = c("timepoint", ".value"), names_pattern = "(baseline|post)_pct_(.*)")
pb <- ggplot(pts, aes(contig, vj, colour = drug_label, shape = timepoint)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") + geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(x = sprintf("Patient MS score (%dth pct), contig", SCORE_PCT), y = "Patient MS score, V-J",
       colour = NULL, shape = NULL, title = "B  Patient scores")

pc <- patient_cmp %>% filter(model == ex) %>%
  ggplot(aes(delta_pct_contig, delta_pct_vj, colour = drug_label)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") + geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Post - pre, contig", y = "Post - pre, V-J", colour = NULL, title = "C  Treatment change per patient")

pd <- tests %>% filter(model == ex) %>%
  mutate(facet = paste0(drug_label, ", ", BSource, " (n = ", n_pairs, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(p.value, fct_rev(facet), colour = variant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = 2, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(contig = "black", contig_pass = "grey60", vj = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "Paired Wilcoxon p", y = NULL, colour = NULL, title = "D  Fig. 3B tests")

p <- (pa | pb) / (pc | pd) & theme_linedraw(base_size = 9) & theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
p
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "figS_treatment_contig_vs_vj.svg"), p, width = 11, height = 8)
```
